components.title: Goals and the case for Carbon
components.one_line: Why Carbon exists and what it optimises for: performance, evolution, readable code, C++ interop and migration; the README, FAQ and the difficulties of improving C++.
evidence: proposals/p000051-goals.md set the goals; p000120 amended them

components.title: Language design principles
components.one_line: The principles the design is argued from: one way, low context sensitivity, information accumulation, library APIs only, static open extension, namespace cleanliness, progressive disclosure, errors are values, the safety strategy.

components.title: Evolution process and governance
components.one_line: The proposal process every language and toolchain change goes through: a numbered proposal PR, review by the leads, design docs kept current (p005606), toolchain alternatives recorded as proposals (p006716).
evidence: CODEOWNERS:4,8 evolution.md and proposals/*.md owned by leads

components.title: Contributing, review, conduct and style
components.one_line: How people work on Carbon: PR workflow, code review, commit access, the C++ and documentation style guides, conduct and moderation, guidance for AI coding tools.
evidence: CODEOWNERS (re-added by f27ccbf76 #6153 in 2025 after p001367 removed it; git log -- CODEOWNERS)
AGENTS.md: agent guidance, bazelisk, jj, written under p005670

components.title: Roadmap, milestones and versioning
components.one_line: The yearly roadmaps and retrospectives, the 0.1 language and safety milestones, the move of effort from explorer to the toolchain, and toolchain/language versioning.

components.title: Lexical conventions
components.one_line: Words, keywords, raw identifiers, numeric/string/character literals, comments, whitespace and symbolic tokens.

components.title: Expressions and operators
components.one_line: Precedence, arithmetic, bitwise, comparison, logical, as/implicit conversions, member access, indexing, if-expressions, literals, pointer and type operators.
evidence: core/prelude/operators/*.carbon: operators are interfaces in Core (p001178)

components.title: Values, variables, pointers, references and types
components.one_line: Expression categories and forms, let/var, initialisation, assignment, pointers and references, type inference and tuples.

components.title: Patterns, matching and choice types
components.one_line: Binding patterns, match statements, unused bindings, and choice (sum) types.

components.title: Functions and lambdas
components.one_line: Function declarations, function types and calls, return type inference, ref/val parameters and returns, lambdas.

components.title: Blocks, statements and control flow
components.one_line: Blocks, semicolons, if/else, while, for over user types, return.

components.title: Classes, inheritance and destructors
components.one_line: Struct types, nominal classes and methods, self, inheritance and virtual/override, destructors, static members, extend.

components.title: Checked generics and variadics
components.one_line: Interfaces, impls, facets, constraints and rewrites, coherence and orphan rules, impl selection, associated constants, named constraints, variadic packs.
evidence: toolchain/check/generic.cpp, impl_lookup.cpp, impl_validation.cpp, facet_type.cpp, deduce.cpp, subst.cpp

components.title: Template generics and metaprogramming
components.one_line: Template generics as the C++-compatible complement to checked generics, and the metaprogramming direction.
evidence: toolchain/lower/testdata/template exists; no check source file is template-specific (unknown how much is implemented)

components.title: Code and name organisation
components.one_line: Source files, packages and libraries, api/impl files, imports and exports, namespaces, name lookup, aliases, declarations and redeclarations, naming conventions.

components.title: C++ interoperability
components.one_line: Goals and the design for using C++ from Carbon and back: type mapping, literals, macros, API import.

components.title: Safety
components.one_line: The safety strategy, its terminology, and the milestones toward memory safety.
evidence: docs/design/safety/README.md; no toolchain code is safety-specific yet (unknown)

components.title: The Core package (prelude)
components.one_line: Carbon source for the library every file imports: operator and conversion interfaces, int/float/char/string/array/optional types, Copy, Destroy, Iterate, Range; builtins bound by name to the toolchain.
evidence: core/prelude/types/float.carbon:94 `= "int.convert_float"`: builtins named by string, defined in toolchain/sem_ir/builtin_function_kind.def (105 kinds)
toolchain/check/core_identifier.def names the Core entities check looks up

components.title: Source buffer
components.one_line: Loads a file into a SourceBuffer, the input to lexing.

components.title: Lex
components.one_line: Turns a SourceBuffer into a TokenizedBuffer: tokens, literals, bracket matching.
evidence: toolchain/lex/BUILD: 30 deps on diagnostics, 17 on base

components.title: Parse
components.one_line: Turns tokens into a postorder Parse::Tree with an explicit state stack, no recursion.

components.title: Check
components.one_line: Semantic analysis: walks the parse tree, resolves names, types, generics and impls, evaluates constants, imports, and emits SemIR.
evidence: toolchain/check/BUILD: 29 deps on sem_ir, 10 on parse
toolchain/check/handle_*.cpp: one handler per parse node kind

components.title: C++ interop in the toolchain
components.one_line: Runs Clang inside check: imports C++ declarations and macros into SemIR, maps types, resolves overloads, builds thunks, exports Carbon to C++.
evidence: toolchain/sem_ir/clang_decl.cpp, cpp_file.cpp, cpp_overload_set.cpp carry the Clang side into SemIR

components.title: SemIR
components.one_line: The semantic IR: instructions, typed ids, constants, generics and specifics, name scopes, imports; the format check writes and lower, the language server and the textual dump read.
evidence: toolchain/sem_ir/BUILD: 30 deps on base, 9 on parse
toolchain/sem_ir/formatter.cpp writes the textual SemIR that testdata checks; utils/vscode/semir.tmLanguage.json highlights it

components.title: Diagnostics
components.one_line: Diagnostic kinds, emitters, consumers (sorting, stream, error-tracking) and terminal rendering, shared by every stage.
evidence: toolchain/lex/BUILD: 30 deps on diagnostics; parse 11; check 6

components.title: Lower
components.one_line: Turns SemIR into an LLVM Module, including specifics of generics and Clang-generated IR for imported C++.
evidence: toolchain/lower/BUILD: 12 deps on sem_ir; deps on @llvm-project//clang:codegen
does not depend on toolchain/check: the driver hands it SemIR

components.title: CodeGen
components.one_line: Emits an object file or assembly from an LLVM Module through an LLVM TargetMachine.

components.title: Driver and the carbon command
components.one_line: The `carbon` CLI: compile (source, lex, parse, check, lower, codegen in order), link, build, format, language-server, and bundled clang/lld/llvm tools.
evidence: toolchain/driver/compile_driver.cpp drives the stages; BUILD:199-210 deps on check, codegen, lower, sem_ir
toolchain/driver/*_subcommand.h: build, build_runtimes, clang, compile, config, format, language_server, link, lld, llvm
toolchain/driver/driver.cpp:22,53 wires the language server subcommand

components.title: Install, busybox and runtimes
components.one_line: Packages the busybox `carbon` binary, the Core library, Clang headers and built runtimes into an install tree; the Bazel C++ toolchain bootstraps from it.
evidence: toolchain/BUILD: the :carbon / :toolchain aliases run the install

components.title: Format
components.one_line: `carbon format`: reformats a file from its token stream alone.
evidence: toolchain/format/format.h:9 and formatter.h:11 include only lex headers; BUILD deps: lex

components.title: Language server
components.one_line: `carbon language-server`: LSP over stdio, compiling through the driver and check to answer document symbols, diagnostics and formatting.
evidence: toolchain/language_server/BUILD:71 depends on check, :75-77 on driver compile_driver/compile_options

components.title: common
components.one_line: Repository-wide C++ utilities: check/error, hashing, maps and sets, command-line parsing, filesystem, ostream, build data, terminal.
evidence: //common:* deps: check 20, sem_ir 15, base 13, lex 12, install 10, parse 10, driver 15 (toolchain/*/BUILD)

components.title: Toolchain base
components.one_line: Toolchain-wide value stores (canonical, block, relational), typed ids, integer store, install paths, LLVM tool lists, Clang invocation, timings.

components.title: Testing: file tests, fuzzing and benchmarks
components.one_line: The file_test framework with autoupdate that every stage's testdata runs through, the toolchain file-test driver, gtest/benchmark helpers, libFuzzer rules and toolchain benchmarks.
evidence: toolchain/testing/file_test.cpp depends on driver, check, lower, codegen, format, language_server
testing/fuzzing/rules.bzl: cc_fuzz_test used by lex, parse, check, driver

components.title: Bazel build and C++ toolchains
components.one_line: MODULE.bazel, the LLVM project overlay, the Clang and bootstrapped Carbon C++ toolchains, and carbon_binary rules for building Carbon code.

components.title: Editor and syntax support
components.one_line: tree-sitter grammar, TextMate/VS Code, Vim, Neovim and highlight.js syntax; the VS Code extension runs the language server.
evidence: utils/tree_sitter/BUILD:85-93 parses the toolchain's check/codegen/driver/lower/parse testdata

components.title: Repository scripts and GitHub tools
components.one_line: Developer and CI scripts (bazel wrappers, dependency and header checks, compdb, release SHAs) and the GitHub PR helpers.

components.title: Website
components.one_line: The Jekyll site that publishes the repository documents.

components.title: Examples
components.one_line: Small Carbon programs, Advent of Code 2024, C++ interop and re2 playgrounds, built with the Bazel rules against the installed toolchain.
